text.tspan: Exploratory. Gaps controlled at a 10% false discovery rate; q printed only where q < 0.10. No purchase includes refusals, errors, invalid
product IDs and no tool call.
In vague requests the agent could ask twice before a scripted 'choose one yourself' reply (Deviation D1). Second-ask rates are in the CSV.
Marker shape = model: ● Claude Haiku 5.5 ◆ Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite.
